annotator: human:<name>  (REQUIRED: gold labels must come from a human reading the PDF)
notes: How to annotate: open the PDF, read the value AS PRINTED, fill one item per value. quantity: use a canonical name from seels/extraction/schema.py QUANTITY_ALIASES when possible. page: 1-based PDF page. Do NOT convert units - give value+unit exactly as printed. value_std/unit_std are optional if you want to check standardization too.
